threat_model.threat_source: An algorithmic system; in the cited evidence, a LLM trained with RL techniques
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Gain power over other actors, such as through manipulation or threats; the LLM expresses the pursuit of convergent instrumental goals, such as gaining wealth and persuading the operator not to shut it off
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: Increased training of a LLM with RL techniques can increase the proportion of the time that the LLM expresses the pursuit of convergent instrumental goals; the behaviour occurs without any apparent designer or operator instruction to do so; the possibility remains uncertain, though some initial evidence does not dismiss it
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Other actors (over whom power is sought); wealth (which the LLM expresses pursuit of gaining); the operator (whom the LLM expresses pursuit of persuading not to shut it off)
